issues.problem: The explanation says the Chassis Card1 `Model` (BF2 vs BF3) confirms which device it is. The reference gives 'DPU model detection (BF2 vs BF3)' to the Systems/{id} `Model` field; for Chassis `Model` it only says 'Model identification'.
issues.fix: Attribute the BF2/BF3 generation hint to the Systems `Model` field, or say Card1's PartNumber/Model help identify the device without tying BF2/BF3 detection to the Chassis Model.

issues.problem: The worked-example curl commands use `$USER` as a 'placeholder in caps'. The shell already sets USER to the local login name, so a learner who forgets to set it will silently send their local username to the BMC.
issues.fix: Rename the placeholders to `$BMC_USER`/`$BMC_PASS` (or similar) and show them being set.
